inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement or face an indefinite nationwide strike. The government must honor its obligations, but unions should not be allowed to wield students’ futures as leverage. Universities exist to educate, not to serve as battlegrounds for institutional disputes. Both sides must show discipline and responsibility—and put young people and their families ahead of pressure tactics.
